title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalamu alaikum Mufti saab; i have a question regarding the UMRAH.i live in Riyadh. I went to makkah to perform UMRAH. I completed my UMRAH there and then went to Jeddah to see my relatives but while returnign i came back to Makkah and immediately got the bus to riyadh. Kindly please advice if i had to perform UMRAH since i came from Jeddah to board the bus in Makkah. If yes, then please advice what should i do now since i have not preformed the later UMRAH. 2874 views Q. At Kabah can we do nafl tawaf on the name of my family members, friends, relatives who are alive? And if we do like that what was the sawab? 32344 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 9020 Country: India Title: Dear Mufti Sahab. I am going haj this year.We are currently export goods.Now we want to export in Saudi araibia.Can we do business in first Haj ?If not then can we give our business card to there importer for future business? Question: Dear Mufti Sahab. I am going haj this year.We are currently export goods.Now we want to export in Saudi araibia.Can we do business in first Haj ?If not then can we give our business card to there importer for future business? Answer ID: 9020 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2087/1918=D/1429) In itself it is lawful, but still it is better to keep one?s hajj free from worldly objectives and travel only for Allah?s sake. (2) It is allowable to do it after performing the necessary amaal of hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
